description: Immutable 180-second checkpoint benchmark; later current-source checks are separate.

changesAfterCheckpoint: Skip shortcut searches for singleton skew constraints.
Allow generated paired via-column spreading at both package ends and outermost pad columns.
Repeat spreading after pair refinement and revalidate the candidate tuple; preserve already-qualified seed geometry and empty curve metadata.

limits: This is the immutable frozen-checkpoint benchmark, not later live-source changes.
All eleven samples have 47 signals; this report does not prove the exact G350 49-signal board.
The historical report allowed 3600 seconds per case; this run allows 180 seconds.
Reported traces on a timeout are provisional. They have no completed routed DRC or length-matching proof.
A killed worker emits default zero counts, zero solve time, and false preservation flags. Missing worker evidence is represented as unknown here; wall time is shown separately.
Historical machine/runtime/load are unpinned; raw timing differences do not isolate a source regression.
The checkpoint and current commit are different source revisions; this report does not benchmark 93f10c15.

inner-layers-right crossed the 180-second budget versus historical 141.706 seconds and the earlier live diagnostic 177.776 seconds. Treat this as a budget regression risk; timing conditions were not controlled.
Only report data is committed here. No route geometry, failed snapshots or images are included.
